scope: Fortran bindings to Lua 5.4, linked with Debian Lua 5.4.7. The manifest library name lua-5.4 is adapted to Linux lua5.4; library sources are unchanged. Adapted from the upstream in-memory string example, the consumer defines a Lua function, passes an integer from Fortran, checks Lua load/call status and function type, verifies the returned integer and closes the state. External scripts, callbacks from Lua to Fortran, arbitrary Lua modules and all bindings are not validated.
